parameters.query:
SELECT i.company_id, i.invoice_number, i.status, i.issued_date, i.due_date, i.amount_due,
       i.holdback_amount, i.net_amount, i.gst_amount, i.pst_amount, i.last_client_html,
       p.title AS project_name,
       COALESCE(NULLIF(c.company_name, ''), c.name) AS customer_name,
       cp.company_name AS our_name, cp.gst_reg_number, cp.pst_reg_number,
       cp.signature_name
FROM invoices i
JOIN projects p ON p.id = i.project_id
JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id
JOIN company_profile cp ON cp.id = i.company_id
WHERE i.id::text = $1 OR i.invoice_number = $1
LIMIT 1;
